name: Deepwater Tavern
summary: At Menethil Harbor, the Deepwater Tavern gives travelers a place to rest and seek work. Sailors and adventurers meet there, and harbor rumors may end in a brawl.

sections.title: Heart of Menethil Harbor
sections.body:
In Menethil Harbor, the Deepwater Tavern offers shelter from the marsh rain and rough roads. Sailors, dockworkers, merchants, and weary adventurers gather beneath its timber beams. They trade news, meet, warm themselves, and tend their wounds.

Local merchants and a first aid trainer help those bound for the marsh or setting out across the Great Sea. The tavern stays lively, and spilled ale can turn a dispute into a brawl. Tapoke 'Slim' Jahn is known to spark them.

faq.q: Where is the Deepwater Tavern located?
faq.answer: The Deepwater Tavern is near the waterfront of Menethil Harbor, the Wetlands' main port on Khaz Modan's western coast.

faq.q: What services are available inside the tavern?
aliases: what can i find at deepwater tavern
faq.answer: The tavern offers lodging and refreshments, with local merchants and a first aid trainer. Travelers through the marshlands can restock supplies and tend their wounds there.

faq.q: Who frequently starts brawls in the tavern?
aliases: who starts fights at deepwater tavern
faq.answer: Tapoke 'Slim' Jahn frequently starts brawls among the tavern's rowdy patrons and sailors.

faq.q: Why is the tavern so busy?
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor is a major shipping and naval gateway between Khaz Modan and Kalimdor. As the town's sole major inn, the Deepwater Tavern draws sailors, mercenaries, and Alliance adventurers heading into the Wetlands.

angles.text: As an Alliance member traveling between Ironforge and the open sea, you can rest and gather at the Deepwater Tavern.
